name: Greattown Holdings Ltd.
summary: Greattown Holdings Ltd. engages in the real estate development business in China. The company operates through Real Estate Business, Financial Investment Business, and Advanced Computing Power Services segments. The company develops residences, urban complexes, office buildings, hotels, tourism and cultural parks, and industrial parks. It also engages in various financial businesses, including insurance, securities, financial leasing, industrial mergers and acquisitions funds, equity investment funds, new energy industry funds, and real estate funds.
